name: Dual Grid Isosurface Extraction with Stitch Cells
definition: A method for extracting continuous, crack-free isosurfaces from cell-centered AMR data by constructing a dual grid (connecting cell centers) to avoid dangling nodes, and filling gaps between hierarchy levels with tessellated 'stitch cells'.
summary: Dual Grid Isosurface Extraction with Stitch Cells extracts crack-free isosurfaces from cell-centered AMR data by connecting cell centers and filling gaps with stitch cells, avoiding dangling nodes and interpolation artifacts.
